answer: Work-slot deposit burning charges each identity for its place. 500 slots each epoch; claiming one needs a 20-unit deposit anchored to it for 20 epochs. A slot is no haven for idle copies: no verified work in an epoch means the deposit is burned, not refunded. The fable of harmless free identities dies on the numbers: 100 fakes burn 100 x 20 = 2,000 units, while one honest agent pays 20 units once. Cost scales with the attack, not with honesty.
